profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Frontend Developer | Designer || Javascript, React.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL
profile.summary: Full-stack developer proficient in Javascript, React, Node.js, HTML and CSS. I also have 10 years of experience as a freelance designer and architect for clients including Disney, Target, Honda, Nintendo, Progressive, AT&T & Dell. My expertise in 2D/3D design programs and my years of experience in remote work have instilled me with creative problem solving skills, self-motivation, and a high attention to detail.

positions.title: Draftsperson
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Disney designers and Rando Productions engineers to construct large-scale mechanical parade floats and theme park sets.
• Created complex Rhino models, architectural drawings, and digital fabrication files while working remotely on a contract basis.
• Projects include a Star Wars Jedi Training Camp, Incredibles parade float, Moana parade float, and a Frozen ride backdrop.

positions.title: Set Designer and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Worked remotely and on set with Production Designer Eric Archer to design and construct several big-budget Target commercial sets.
• Created SketchUp models, Illustrator graphics, and Photoshop visualizations in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
• Projects include several Back-to-School commercials, Holiday commercials, and a Grammys music video/commercial.

positions.title: Architect
positions.description:
• Assisted Danish artist Jeppe Hein in the design and construction of interactive public art projects throughout Europe and the USA. 
• Led multiple large-scale projects as Project Architect, including pavilions, modified public benches, and interactive kinetic sculptures.
• Responsible for creating new concepts, 3d models, architectural drawings, and visualizations.

projects.title: Parallels, A Graphic Novel
projects.description: Wrote, illustrated, and designed a full-length graphic novel about a series of fantastical parallel worlds. Intimate stories and otherworldly drawings reimagine fundamental human experiences like dreams, thoughts, anxiety and creativity.
